subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: Which session activity contract and Control UI scope should own the compact active-run progress surface requested here?
rationale: The requested UI needs state beyond current `status` and `hasActiveRun`, while related open issues and PRs propose overlapping API and presentation boundaries that require maintainer product/API direction.

options.title: Make activity canonical first
options.body: Use the broader session activity API/statechange design as the source of truth, then build the compact Control UI strip on top of it.

options.title: Narrow an open PR
options.body: Adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96672 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92697 only after trimming it to the agreed API and UX boundary.

options.title: Defer the strip
options.body: Keep the current coarse status UI until maintainers are ready to own the broader session activity semantics.

recommendation.title: Make activity canonical first
recommendation.body: Use the broader session activity API/statechange design as the source of truth, then build the compact Control UI strip on top of it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-path history across the Control UI chat and gateway/session method code involved in the decision.
